notes: Track instrumental uploads from MuseScore’s first 100 community score pages, sorted by view count. The ranking snapshot contains 2,000 distinct scores, inspected on 3 October 2026. The current Rawl category contains 82 MIDI entries; that does not establish 82 eligible composers or completed uploads.
## Selection rules

Follow the [original corpus philosophy](http://localhost:3000/corpus/top_100_musescore_composers): choose one work per composer using the highest viewed individual score, without adding views across arrangements. Represent the chosen work with a suitable solo piano arrangement, even when its highest viewed score uses other instruments. Keep the existing attribution exceptions for Klaus Badelt and Luo Ni, and skip Musa Çetiner’s Turkish tabs. For this instrumental category, exclude arrangements of songs with lyrics. Wordless voices and samples need case by case review.
## How to record progress

For each score, record one outcome: already represented, uploaded and added, duplicate composer, vocal work, attribution review, or needs a solo piano arrangement. Check a source item only after recording that outcome; check a page after every score on it has been resolved. Keep the highest ranked eligible work for each composer. An existing Rawl link confirms a corpus reference, not that playback or MIDI availability has been tested.
[Current instrumental category](http://localhost:3000/corpus/musescore_instrumental_top) · [All Rawl pieces](http://localhost:3000/corpus/) · [Rawl MIDI editor](http://localhost:3000/e/)
